title: Delegated template-fallback plans reach the governed delivery-injection authority — TRUE Telegram intent no longer un-plannable (BUG 4)
description: HOTFIX-D R4 minimal closure — P1 persisted-provenance authenticity + P2 alias/CAS collision. P1: reconcilePlanDataflow re-derives consumes from prior pair_dataflow_sources stamps ONLY when ReconcileOptions.trusted_persisted_plan is set, and serve-planner sets it solely on the metadata.llm_plan persisted-replay path (fresh planner output, replan candidates, template tasks: reserved rows strip with zero effect). Even then each stamped row must prove canonical origin against the CURRENT durable eligible set — artifact_id plus every pinned identity field, the same re-proof resolveExternalSourceInput performs at dispatch; forged, ghosted or drifted persisted stamps fail closed FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_EXTERNAL_INPUT. P2: consume binding evaluates BOTH canonical logical-name equivalence AND the identity-pinned alias; same identity binds, different identities fail closed FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE (never silent preference), >1 matches ambiguous, none unbound as before. Mandatory tests T1-T7: forged fresh/persisted stamps inject nothing or fail closed, legitimate persisted plans replay canonically identical, alias-named artifacts bind by name, alias-vs-name identity conflict fails closed, out-of-set declarations fail closed, eligibility drift fails closed. 47/47 hotfix-d tests; hotfix A/B/C 69/69; 553/554 regression (sole fail = pair-f4-delivery-provenance R5.1-crash, identical on BASE cf2674c, unrelated module); tsc/build clean.
